paper_title: SRPO Enhancing Multimodal LLM Reasoning via Reflection-Aware   Reinforcement Learning
caption_used: Accuracy comparison of six reinforcement learning configurations across three benchmarks: Mathverse, MMLU, and Physics. Each benchmark displays grouped bars for DAPO+Self-reflection (solid blue), DAPO (hatched blue), SRPO (solid orange), GRPO (hatched orange), PPO+Self-reflection (solid green), and PPO (hatched green). In Mathverse, SRPO achieves the highest accuracy at approximately 56%, while DAPO+Self-reflection follows at roughly 55%, with the remaining methods clustered between 53% and 54%. Across MMLU, GRPO leads with approximately 57%, narrowly exceeding DAPO+Self-reflection, and PPO trails at about 54.5%. In the Physics benchmark, DAPO+Self-reflection reaches roughly 61%, with SRPO close behind at 60.5% and PPO at the lowest with approximately 57%. Notably, the self-reflection variants do not consistently outperform their base counterparts, as GRPO surpasses PPO+Self-reflection in both Mathverse and MMLU.

The bars within each group are not ordered by value, but rather by the configuration type as indicated by the legend.

model_annotations.English: The chart illustrates the accuracy comparison of six reinforcement learning configurations across three benchmarks: Mathverse, MMLU, and Physics. The horizontal axis contains the categories, which are the three benchmarks, labeled as Mathverse, MMLU, and Physics, in that order. The vertical axis represents the accuracy percentage, labeled as "Accuracy (%)", with a linear scale ranging from 50 to 62, with tick labels at every 2 units. For each benchmark, there are six grouped bars representing the different reinforcement learning configurations: DAPO+Self-reflection (solid blue), DAPO (hatched blue), SRPO (solid orange), GRPO (hatched orange), PPO+Self-reflection (solid green), and PPO (hatched green). The bars are grouped by benchmark, with the six configurations displayed together for each. In Mathverse, the accuracy values range from approximately 53% to 56%, with SRPO being the tallest at around 56% and PPO being one of the shortest at around 53%. In MMLU, the accuracy values range from about 54.5% to 57%, with GRPO being the tallest at approximately 57% and PPO being the shortest at around 54.5%. In Physics, the accuracy values range from approximately 57% to 61%, with DAPO+Self-reflection being the tallest at around 61% and PPO being the shortest at around 57%. The bars are not sorted in any particular order within each group, and no bars are visually emphasized beyond their color and hatching patterns as indicated in the legend.
model_annotations.German: This chart compares the accuracy of six reinforcement learning configurations - DAPO+Self-reflection, DAPO, SRPO, GRPO, PPO+Self-reflection, and PPO - across three benchmarks: Mathverse, MMLU, and Physics. The benchmarks are listed along the horizontal axis in the order of Mathverse, MMLU, and Physics, while the vertical axis represents the accuracy percentage, ranging from 50% to 62% with tick labels at every 2% interval. For each benchmark, the six configurations are grouped together and represented by bars of different colors and patterns: solid blue for DAPO+Self-reflection, hatched blue for DAPO, solid orange for SRPO, hatched orange for GRPO, solid green for PPO+Self-reflection, and hatched green for PPO. In the Mathverse benchmark, the accuracy values range from approximately 53% to 56%, with SRPO being the highest and PPO being the lowest. In MMLU, the values range from about 54.5% to 57%, with GRPO being the highest and PPO being the lowest. In Physics, the accuracy values are higher, ranging from approximately 57% to 61%, with DAPO+Self-reflection being the highest and PPO being the lowest. Notably, the bars are grouped by benchmark, allowing for a clear comparison of the different configurations within each benchmark, and the legend indicates that the self-reflection variants are represented by solid colors, while their base counterparts are represented by hatched patterns.
